narrative.northStar: Modern Minimal Course Atlas & Self-Explanatory Race Ledger
narrative.overview: RunEvent unites a Modern Minimal public race discovery & merchandise storefront portal (#f7f8fa canvas, #ffffff surface cards, route illustrations, net-price clarity) with a self-explanatory multi-tenant Organizer Dashboard anchored by a #0f172a context rail, urgent action queue, 4-stage lifecycle guide, and satang-accurate BibLedgerStrip.
keyCharacteristics: Modern minimal public discovery cards with vector route covers and instant net-price clarity
Self-explanatory Organizer Dashboard headers explaining what every screen is and what it controls
Unified Email/Password, Google, and LINE simulated account model separated from Demo Preset switching
Tabular JetBrains Mono numerals across race quotas, THB fee equations, and non-duplicated shirt RFQ calculations

rules.name: The Slate-Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: Muted text, borders, and placeholders derive from #0f172a slate rather than pure neutral grey.

rules.name: The Icon-Plus-Label Status Rule
rules.body: Every status pill pairs a 1.75px stroke SVG icon with an explicit Thai status phrase; color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Self-Sufficient Heading Rule
rules.body: Never stack uppercase kickers or eyebrow labels above h1, h2, or h3.

rules.name: The Single-Line Affordance Rule
rules.body: Buttons, nav pills, and filter chips enforce white-space: nowrap so Thai/English labels never wrap awkwardly mid-phrase.

dos: Do explain every Organizer section in plain Thai so first-time users immediately know what each screen controls.
Do keep race registration entitlements separate from standalone storefront merchandise orders and custom production quotes.
Do render every THB amount, fee breakdown, and quota counter in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums and satang-accurate integer math.
donts: Don't place eyebrow kickers above headings or thick (>1px) side/top borders on rounded cards.
Don't auto-merge accounts on email collision or allow unlinking a user's last remaining login method.
Don't imply real server persistence, real Google/LINE OAuth, or live payment processing in demo copy.
